dedup.scope: Same-source public primary and both claims already prepared from this source, plus the public identity index, the retired-claims record and the current worklist searched with the object names asymptotic separation index, asymptotic dimension, injective G-ray, annulus, rainbow and Borel edge coloring.

compared.difference: Same source, different proposition: lem:quotient (source lines 347-364) lifts an edge colouring of the Schreier graph of the quotient by a finite subgroup and re-colours the resulting two-orbit components. It contains no asymptotic separation index, no injective ray and no annulus construction.

Counts Theorem th:d+1 (source lines 84-86), the Vizing-type bound on the Borel edge chromatic number under asi_B=1. The present lemma is one of the two lemmas the author proves in order to obtain that bound, so it is upstream of it rather than a corollary; its conclusion is about rays and annuli, not about chromatic numbers.

Counts Theorem th:Z^d (source lines 98-105), the exact Borel edge chromatic numbers for Bernoulli actions of abelian groups; proved in Section 3 by protocol transitions, a different mechanism that never mentions rays or annuli.
